descriptions.w3d_component_list_get_800a54d8: Returns the global registry list that tracks every instance of this component type.
descriptions.w3d_component_unlink_800a54e4: Removes a component from its type registry list and decrements the registry count.
descriptions.w3d_component_create_800a5528: Allocates and constructs a component, links it into its type registry and increments the count.
